chunk_list: VERDANT FEDERATED DATA SPACE ARCHITECTURE V1.0 1. Purpose VERDANT studies interoperable exchange of energy products among SolCentro, Instituto Técnico do Norte, and NEXUS. The architecture is federated: original readings remain within the infrastructure of the partner generating them, while authorized consumers receive catalogues and derived products under explicit rules. The design seeks interoperability, minimization, traceability, and revocation. Technical ability to query data is not authorization. Every product declares its purpose, owner, policy, version, provenance, and availability period. 2. Scope The pilot includes a catalogue, connectors, certificates, policies, hourly and daily products, auditing, and tests. Fifteen-minute readings do not leave SolCentro except under a specific temporary exception. The architecture does not cover billing, installation control, or automated decisions about people. 3. Principles The source retains authority over data. Federation exchanges descriptions and results and does not require centralized copies. Products may be withdrawn or superseded without losing history. Least privilege applies to accounts, networks, operations, and fields. Every transformation is reproducible, and logs contain no secrets or complete bodies.

Architecture section 1 Catalogue: the component publishes descriptions, schemas, coverage, owner, licence, policy, and endpoint; it contains no original readings. It has an owner, inputs, outputs, metrics, and acceptance criteria. Review checks that documentation matches the deployed configuration and that simulated policies produce the same result. Component 1 retains a rollback procedure, known limitations, and evidence. Corrections are applied through version control and preserve the earlier result for auditing.
